instruction:
Two-software CAE flow: SolidWorks -> Abaqus/CAE. No init file is provided; start from a new blank SolidWorks part.

Chain evidence requirement: use the design token EW_SW_ABQ_08. Keep this token encoded in the SolidWorks part/custom properties or STEP export metadata so the text of stage1_geometry.step contains EW_SW_ABQ_08 and SOLIDWORKS_TO_ABAQUS. In Abaqus/CAE, create at least one model, part, instance, set, surface, job description, or other native name containing both EW_SW_ABQ_08 and IMPORTED_FROM_stage1_geometry.step, so the final CAE file carries evidence that Abaqus consumed the SolidWorks STEP handoff.

1. In SolidWorks, use sketch and feature tools to create a 100 mm x 50 mm x 5 mm base heat spreader with two 5 mm thick side walls rising to about 25 mm total height and a flat bottom heat-pad face. Export the completed CAD geometry to C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step.
2. In Abaqus/CAE, import stage1_geometry.step and create the finite-element model. Use the model name Model-UChannelThermal. Define material Aluminum with conductivity about 170 W/m-K, create a section using Aluminum, and assign it to the U-channel. Create a steady heat transfer step named Step-Thermal. Create a set named HEAT_PAD and a surface named CONVECTION_SURFACES. Use first-order heat-transfer elements such as DC3D8 where practical or coarse DC3D4 where needed. Create a heat flux load named HeatFlux-Base on HEAT_PAD. Create a convection interaction or equivalent boundary condition named BC-Convection on CONVECTION_SURFACES. Submit the job named Job-UChannelThermal and wait for the analysis to complete.
3. Required deliverables on the Desktop: C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step, C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-UChannelThermal.cae, and C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-UChannelThermal.odb. Do not create extra STEP, DXF, CAE, or ODB deliverables.

 First use SolidWorks to create and export the CAD STEP file, then use Abaqus/CAE to import that STEP file, build the finite-element model, submit the job, and save the CAE and ODB deliverables.
